newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator slumps seven cts/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator slumps seven cts/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator dropped by seven cents to 560 cents a kg clean at sales in Sydney on Monday, Wool International (WI) said.
Merino fleece prices were lower across the board, with 19/21/22 and 23 micron one percent cheaper and 20 micron was up to 2.5 percent cheaper.
Merino skirtings were also one percent cheaper while crossbreds were mixed, with 27 micron 0.5 percent dearer and 28 to 31 microns two percent cheaper.
In cardings, locks and crutchings were generally unchanged.
Wool International said most competition came from Japan and China with good support from most sectors of the trade.
Of the 10,696 bales offer, 10.6 percent were passed in, it said.
Sales continued on Tuesday in Sydney and Geelong with about 25,900 bales on offer.
